## Review checklist

- [ ] The referenced specification is accepted, or this PR changes only the specification itself.
- [ ] Scope changes discovered during implementation are reflected in the specification.
- [ ] Relevant ADRs, tests, documentation, and release evidence are linked.
- [ ] Unsupported provider behavior fails before transport execution.
- [ ] Formatting, build, tests, coverage, package, and security gates pass.
